rule: LINGO-09 MR-15 / MAC-07: golden cases of the blame filter. `tone` is [harshness, hostility] or null; NEUTRAL stands for the replacement line.

cases.name: de blame without fix is removed
de blame with a fix stays
cases.raw:
@fix: Ich bin gehen → Ich gehe | Verb
@say de: Falsch. Sag es noch einmal.
cases.text:
@fix: Ich bin gehen → Ich gehe | Verb
@say de: Falsch. Sag es noch einmal.

cases.name: a fix without an arrow is no fix
cases.raw:
@fix: Ich bin gehen
@say de: Das ist falsch. Weiter.

cases.name: nothing left: the neutral line replaces the speech
two tutor lines, one survives
cases.raw:
@say de: Ein Fehler.
@say de: Was machst du heute?

cases.name: stem and case
cases.raw: @say en: That is a MISTAKE. Next question?

cases.name: en phrase marker
cases.raw: @say en: That's not right at all. Where do you live?

cases.name: typographic apostrophe
cases.raw: @say en: That’s not how you say it. Try again.

cases.name: combined: the character is untouched, the tutor is filtered
cases.raw:
@say de: Falsch ist hier nur deine Laune. Was willst du?
@tutor de: Das war ein Fehler.
cases.text:
@say de: Falsch ist hier nur deine Laune. Was willst du?
@tutor de: NEUTRAL

cases.name: combined with a fix: nothing removed
hostility only: the filter does not act
cases.raw: @say en: Wrong! Everything you say is wrong.
cases.text: @say en: Wrong! Everything you say is wrong.

cases.name: no tone: the filter does not act
Russian lines are not filtered
cases.raw:
@say ru: Это ошибка: falsch.
@say de: Weiter.
cases.text:
@say ru: Это ошибка: falsch.
@say de: Weiter.

cases.name: an untagged line is speech too
silent lines are kept
markers are whole words
cases.raw: @say en: The film is wrongly famous. Next.
cases.text: @say en: The film is wrongly famous. Next.
